senses.gloss: branch, bough, opp. to אשכול the trunk with the grape clusters.
(b. h.) pr. n. Pisgah, the summit of Mount Nebo.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 357:3">Sifré Deut. 357</cite> (ref. to XXXIV, 1) <he>מה פ׳ זו מופרשת מן האשכול ואינה מופרשת וכ׳</he> as the branch is separate from the trunk, yet not detached, so was Moses’ grave &c., v. <cite ref="V00025"><he>תָאַם</he></cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 963">Yalk. ib. 963</cite>.
